title: Citation and Attribution
description: CAT 100 textbook section on citation and attribution, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Apply the four attribution obligations (trace the source, check the license, verify the exact figure or quote location, disclose AI authorship) to a borrowed chart, a quotation, and an AI-generated asset

Distinguish citation (making a borrowed fact or asset checkable) from AI-use disclosure (making your own slide's authorship honest), and distinguish public-domain government works from CC-licensed third-party assets
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
